verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents first-party M2M applications under AuthKit Connect that issue API access credentials so callers can programmatically access your APIs. This sits alongside AuthKit being a spec-compatible OAuth authorization server, and OAuth applications are explicitly scoped to cases where the authenticated actor is a user, which positions M2M for non-human callers. Missing for 10: explicit naming of the client-credentials grant and token-issuance details, credential rotation/scoping docs, agent-specific usage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
